redFirst.basis: regression task with expectRedFirst false; the added check widens an existing case to a second child suite and was run green

outcome.technical: Chose (a). tools/sweep-selftests.py locale_decision pins no locale on Windows (nt) and drops the pin when a child reports non-UTF-8 file names, so the sweep's --encoding pass is not a whole-suite ASCII cover on every platform; (b) alone would leave those with no ASCII run. Added _integrate_ascii_case to plugins/audit/tests/test_drive_phase.py (constant INTEGRATE_SUITE), called from _ascii_locale_cases: runs test_integrate_task.py --selftest whole as a child under ASCII_ENV, checks exit 0 and tally passed==total>0. Manually confirmed that suite gives 27/27 under LC_ALL=C LANG=C PYTHONUTF8=0 (rc 0, ~24s). Full sweep python3 tools/sweep-selftests.py: 335/335 files ok. Only file changed: plugins/audit/tests/test_drive_phase.py. The drive suite's other blocks are still not re-run under ASCII; only fm-block and the integrate suite are.
outcome.descriptive: The ASCII-locale case now also runs the whole integrate suite, closing the clause-3 gap.

testsAdded: plugins/audit/tests/test_drive_phase.py: under a locale whose preferred encoding is ASCII, the integrate suite runs whole and every case it reports passes
